content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Tripura University CRS Project Fellow (Junior I) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tripura University CRS Project Fellow (Junior-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CRS Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. (1st class) or M.Sc. (minimum 55% marks) in relevant fields like Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or Materials Science.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job opportunity?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CRS Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 14,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of CRS Project Fellow (Junior-I).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Tripura University located?
faq.answer: Tripura University is located in Suryamaninagar, Tripura, with the pincode 799022.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is F.TU\/FIN(504)\/(P)\/2026-27\/1.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification is for Tripura University, and while not explicitly stated, it is generally open to eligible candidates across India unless specified otherwise.
